text: Anesthesiology is a medical discipline that studies clinical anesthesia, regulation of life functions, monitoring and treatment of severe cases, and diagnosis and treatment of pain. It aims to provide safe and comfortable anesthesia guarantees for surgical patients and plays a key role in areas such as emergency and critical care treatment and pain management. This major integrates basic medicine (such as physiology and pharmacology) with clinical medicine (such as internal medicine and surgery), emphasizing the combination of theory and practice, and aims to cultivate professional talents with the ability to perform precise anesthesia operations, handle emergency situations, and collaborate across multiple disciplines.
